warnings: Every column position prints a footing mark and a column mark side by side: 'F1 | C1' on all seven positions of row A and 'F2 | C1' on all seven positions of row B. F2 is drawn visibly larger than F1, consistent with the footing details on S-05 (F1 1.30 x 1.30 on 9 piles, F2 1.30 x 1.80 on 12 piles).
Row C (corridor edge) has no footing — the corridor is carried by the cantilever beams B3' (S-02 / S-07). The plan prints only the 6.50 A-B dimension on the y axis.
Footing/column specs are on the detail sheet S-05 (page 21) and join by element_id.
